column1: # Blind labels for tools/subject_tags.py (Book XIV ch 5). subject_tags.py detects nothing: docs/subjects.tsv is an editorial decision.
# This set records whether a second, BLIND reading of the same page reaches the same subject.
# Sample: 60 chapters drawn with random.seed(20261114) from the chapters with a non-apparatus row (tools/subject_tags_sheet.py),
# working tree of commit a6c657d3 after regeneration. Labeller 1 (Claude, one session) saw only title, description and the opening
# of the text, with no tag, and chose from VOCAB. Labeller 1 is the same model that wrote many of the rows in subjects.tsv, so
# agreement here is NOT independent evidence. A second labeller fills the same blind sheet; tools/gold_agreement.py compares.
